It also recently stopped reporting some metrics for its entertainment segment, such as a breakdown of revenue and operating income for its linear TV networks. Theme parks remain a driver of revenue and profit. But the effects of the U.S.-Israel conflict with Iran and related jump in oil prices have affected some of Disney's peers.
